description: Teardown plugin: decommissions the HCP Terraform deployment backing the resource. Clears orphaned non-final TFC runs (attribution-aware: only runs whose owning CloudBolt job is no longer running or paused; fails fast naming a live job; waits out a run mid-apply), creates an auto-confirmed destroy run, then deletes the workspace via the safe-delete endpoint only -- never force-delete. Idempotent: a missing workspace ID or already-deleted workspace returns WARNING, not FAILURE.
name: Teardown HCP Terraform VM
